title: Side Moulding and Garnish
ocr_text:
Side Moulding and Garnish
COMPONENTS

Roof Drip Front Moulding
Joint Cover
Center Pillar Garnish
Roof Drip Rear Moulding
Quarter Corner Moulding
Quarter Belt Moulding
Door Belt Moulding
Rocker Panel Moulding
Outside Moulding

80068

REMOVAL OF ROOF DRIP MOULDING

PULL OFF ROOF DRIP MOULDING
(a) Using SST, pull off the joint cover.
(b) Using SST, pull off the roof drip moulding from both ends.

SST 09806 30010
NOTE: Remove the moulding corners last.

SST

INSTALLATION OF ROOF DRIP MOULDING

INSTALL DRIP MOULDING BY HAND
(a) Attach the upper edge of the moulding to the body flange.
Fit the moulding by tapping it by hand.
(b) Install the joint cover.
